subject: BridgeFold / AWS co-sell demo — slot reslice and split-run proposal
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@bridgefold.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeFold / AWS co-sell demo — initial timing options

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. BridgeFold and our AWS SI (Mike Reynolds) are aligned to run a joint co-sell demo for the prospective customer (Summit Financial). AWS would like Redwood on the call to surface performance/cost comparisons for a multi-region inference pipeline, and BridgeFold will lead the customer narrative.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Mon Jul 24: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Tue Jul 25: 09:00–11:00 (preferred by the customer)
- Wed Jul 26: 15:00–16:30 (APAC-friendly wrap)

Attached is a short agenda and the high-level slide deck (bridgefold-demo-agenda.pdf). Mike mentioned there may be an AWS product-SPA who wants a short pre-demo tech sync. Can you confirm Redwood availability and whether you prefer a single 90–120 min slot or a split run (technical deep-dive + customer-facing session)?

If you share a couple of firm windows I can lock in the AWS attendees.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Partnerships 
BridgeFold Solutions

Attachments: bridgefold-demo-agenda.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@bridgefold.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeFold / AWS co-sell demo — initial timing options

Alex —

Appreciate the agenda. Redwood can support a co-hosted session; for Summit Financial we recommend keeping the customer-facing portion concise (30–45m) and pairing it with a deeper technical run for the SI + SEs (60–75m). That reduces context switching for the customer and gives the AWS/BridgeFold engineers space to validate load/latency scenarios.

Availability (PDT):
- Tue Jul 25: 09:00–11:00 (we can do the split: 09:00–09:45 customer + 09:50–11:00 technical)
- Mon Jul 24: 13:00–14:30 (tight, prefer Tue)

Pre-demo ops: can we do a 30m prep call 24 Jul 11:00–11:30 PDT to walk run-of-show and who shares which slides? I attached our co-sell runbook for logistics (redwood-co-sell-runbook.docx) — includes suggested slide ownership and bandwidth checklist. Also please drop the HubSpot record for Summit so we can attach the invite and copy the deal owner.

If that Tue slot works for AWS, I'll draft invites and a single calendar block with two internal conference rooms (customer + backstage channel).

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-co-sell-runbook.docx
From: Alex Park <alex.park@bridgefold.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeFold / AWS co-sell demo — initial timing options

Karthik —

Thanks for the rundown and the runbook — super helpful. Quick update from AWS: Mike's SE team has a customer-facing commitment in the morning on Tue 25 that conflicts with the 09:00 customer slot. They can join the technical run if we shift the customer-facing piece slightly earlier or split the session across two adjacent blocks.

Two options from our side:
1) Single contiguous 2-hour block Tue Jul 25 08:30–10:30 PDT (customer join first 30–45m, then technical) — AWS can make the tech portion but will miss the very start unless we start earlier. 
2) Split run: Customer-facing 08:30–09:15 PDT, quick 15m break, technical 09:30–10:45 PDT. This keeps both AWS and customer calendars mostly intact.

We also have an operations worksheet (aws-sla-matrix.xlsx) — attaching. If Redwood prefers not to start before 09:00, option 2 still works with customer at 09:00 and tech 09:30, but that shortens the customer segment.

Quote from your earlier message:
> Availability (PDT):
> - Tue Jul 25: 09:00–11:00 (we can do the split: 09:00–09:45 customer + 09:50–11:00 technical)

Can your ops team confirm whether an 08:30 start is possible or if we should go with the split at 09:00/09:30 and accept a shorter customer-facing window?

Cheers,
Alex

Attachments: aws-sla-matrix.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@bridgefold.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeFold / AWS co-sell demo — initial timing options

Alex / Karthik —

Quick ops note from Redwood side: we prefer not to start internal speaker prep before 08:45 PDT, and our standard customer-facing window ideally sits between 09:00–10:00. Given the constraints, here's what I can commit to and what I'd recommend:

Final proposal (PDT):
- Tue Jul 25: 09:00–09:40 — Customer-facing overview (40m)
- 09:40–09:50 — Short break / lobby for backstage handoff (10m)
- 09:50–11:05 — Technical deep-dive (75m)

Prep: Mon Jul 24 11:00–11:30 PDT — internal run-of-show + slide ownership (remote)

I'll create the calendar blocks and include a separate backstage Google Meet link for logins and screen-sharing. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=bridgefold-demo-final (please treat as tentative until HubSpot deal owner confirms).

Vanessa — can you coordinate the invite with the Summit AE and copy the HubSpot record (DF-8342)? Alex — once you confirm AWS can do the technical block starting at 09:50 we can send invites.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
